vpr_lu8_commits.subject: [place] Criticality-weighted FR centroid target for moving block outputs
vpr_lu8_commits.message:
[place] Criticality-weighted FR centroid target for moving block outputs

Replace single output-driver target point (xt,yt) with criticality-weighted
centroid of all critical output sinks (fanout<=15, crit>place_crit_limit).
Falls back to original output driver location when no critical sinks found.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

vpr_lu8_commits.subject: [place] Tournament selection for critical pin picking in pick_from_highly_critical_block
vpr_lu8_commits.message:
[place] Tournament selection for critical pin picking in pick_from_highly_critical_block

Bias FR and CRIT_UNIFORM moves toward highest-criticality connections by
tournament-selecting 2 random critical pins and keeping the more critical one.
Inspired by ripple-fpga dp_ble.cpp quality-sorted candidate approach.

vpr_lu8_commits.subject: [pack] Connectivity-weighted base_gain for single-atom molecules
vpr_lu8_commits.message:
[pack] Connectivity-weighted base_gain for single-atom molecules

Use inverse-fanout scoring for single-atom molecule base_gain to improve
unrelated clustering fill order, inspired by FPGAPart's GetNormEdgeScore.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

vpr_lu8_commits.subject: [pack] Neighbor-absorption-potential seed scoring for BLEND2
vpr_lu8_commits.message:
[pack] Neighbor-absorption-potential seed scoring for BLEND2

Add connectivity-weighted neighbor absorption potential term to BLEND2
seed gain. Molecules whose direct neighbors are timing-critical and
tightly coupled (low-fanout) score higher as seeds, inspired by
FPGAPart coarsener vertex matching.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
